m: इध्माबर्हिस् [Pāṇ. ii, 4, 14] n. sg. and (इषी) du. fuel and grass.

s: klI, (inDa + mak .) agnisandIpanakAzWam । ityamaraH ॥ jAlAni kAWa iti BAzA । (“tatreDmAnayane Sukro niyuktaH kaSyapena ha” । iti BArate .)
v: na॰ iDyate'gniranena inDa--mak । 1 kAzWe “yasta iDma jatarat sizvidAnaH” f॰ 4, 2, 6, “iDmaM kAzWaBAram” BA॰ । 2 yajYiyasamidBede pu॰ । tatpramARakaraRaprakArAdi kAtyA॰ SrO॰ darTitam । “ayugDAtU ni yUnAni” sU॰ । “iDmabanDanabarhirbanDanArTAni yUnAni saMnahanAni rajjavo'yugDAtUni Bavanti । DAtavastfRamuzwiprakzepAH ayujo vizamA ekatripaYcasaptanavAdivizasasaMKyA DAtavoyezAM tAnyayugDAtUni । taTA cApastambaH “triDAtu paYcaDAtu vA SulvaM karotIti” SulvaM rajjumityarTaH । “paYcaviMSatikuSamayAni yUnAni” iti yajYapArSve । taTA “samUlAnAmasUlAnAM vA darBARAM pUrvavat SulvaM kftvodagagraM niDAyeti” iDmaprastAve । mAnave ca “SulvaM pratidaDAtyayugDAtu pradakziRamiti” । tittirisUtre । “aTatriranvAhitaM SulvaM kftveti” karka॰ barhizo banDana prakAramAha । “prAgagre yUnOdagagraM barhirAcinoti” sU॰ । prAgagre yUne prAgagre saMnahane banDanArTAyAM rajjO udagagraM barhirAcinoti banDanArTa sTApayati” karka॰ । aTeDmabanDanasya prakAramAha । “udagagre prAgagramiDmam” sU॰ । AcinotItyanuvartate udagagre yUne sanahane prAgagramiDmamAcinoti banDanArTaM nidaDAti” karka॰ । “pratyaggranTInavagUhati” sU॰ । iDmavarhirbanDanArTAnAM yUnAnAM granTIn pratyagavagUhati yUne gAQaM badDvA yUnasyAgramUle saMkalpya pradakziRamAvezwya iDmabarhizoragraBAge protayitvA paScAditi tayormUlaBAge avagUhati prerayati pratyakSabdena iDmabarhizoHpaScAdBAgo mUlaBAga ityucyate digvAcinovarhitTudagagre nihite asamBavAt । kmaWake “granTi kftvA purastAt pratyaYcamapakarzatIti” । mAnave “SulvasyAntO samAyagya “pUzA te granTimiti” pradakziRamAvezwayati paScAt pratyaYcamapakarzatIti” tEttirIye'pi “paScAtprAYcamupagUhatIti” । ApastambaH “purastAt pratyaYcaM granTimupagUhati paScAdvA prAYcamiti” । “azwAdaSeDmaM pariDivfkzARAm” sU॰ । “pariDInAM vfkzAH palASaKadiravikaNkatAdayaH pariDivfkzAH tezAM pariDivfkzARAM sambanDinaH azwAdaSasaMKyakAzWakamiDmaM kuryyAt । mAnaye “samUlErdarBEH pAlASaM KAdiraM rOhitakaM vAzwAdaSadArviDmaM saMnahyati triMSca pariDIn yoyajYiyavfkzastasyeti” । kAWake “azwAdaSadAru SulvaM samAnavfkzasya saMnahyati viMSati mizwO paSubanDe ceti” । ataeva sAmiDenIvivfdDO kAzWa vfdDirBavati hrAse ca hrAso na Bavati pitryAdO, taTAhApastambaH “sAmiDenIvivfdDO kAzWAni vivarDante prakftito hrasamAnAsu prakftivaditi” । upasatsu tu “mAtrAvadiDmA barhiriti” vacanAt hrAsaH । “iDmapramARaM cAratniriti sadBiH prakIrtitamiti” kAtyAyanaH (karmapradIpe) taTA “samitpavitraM vedaM ca kuryyAt prAdeSasaMmitam । iDmastu dviguRaH kAryyaH pariDistriguRaH smftaH” “smArte prAdeSa iDmo vA dviguRaH pariDistata” iti । “ekaviMSati vA” sU॰ । aTa vA ekaviMSatimekaviSatisaKyAkakAzWakamiDmaM kuryyAt taTA cApastambaH “KAdiraM pAlASaM vEkaviMSatidArukamiDmaM karoti” । “tataH pariDIneke” sU॰ । eke AcAryAstata ekaviMSatisaMKyakAzWakAdiDmAttrIRi kAzWAnyaratni mAtrARyevopAdAya pariDIn paridaDati “tadDekEDmasyEvEtAn pariDIn paridaDatIti” SruteH । aTa vEkamevedaM sUtram “ekaviMSati vA tataH pariDIneke” iti eke AcAryyA vikalpena ekaviMSatisaMKyakAzWamiDmaM kurvanti tata iti tasmAdevEkaviMSatikAzWakeDmAt pariDIn paridaDati ca । etadeva yuktataram ApastambasUtre ekaviMSatikAzWAnAM viBAgadarSanAt । taTAcAhApastambaH “KAdiraM pAlASaM vEkaviMSatidArukamiDmaM karoti trayaH pariDayaH pAlASakAzWakAH KAdirodumbaravilvarohitakavikaNkatAnAM ye vA yajYiyA vfkzA ArdrAH SuzkA vA satvackAH, sTavizWo maDyamo'RIyAndrADIyAndakziRArDyo hrasizWa uttarArDyo dve, ADAra samiDAvanuyAja samidekaviMRatiH samUlAnAmamUlAnAM vA darBARAM pUrvvavacCulvaM kftvodagagraM niDAyeti” । aTa evaMviDamekIyamatam yadekaviMSatikAzWakaH iDmaH । tasmin pakze ceDmAdeva trIRi kAzWAnyAdAya pariGipariDAnamiti । banDanAnantaramiDmavarhizorBUmO niDAnaM na kAyam ApastambasUtre anaDonidaDAtItyuktatvAt । tadDEka iDmasyEvEtAm pariDIn paridaDatItyatna harisvABinaH tadu taTA na kuryyAdanavakla'ptA hi tasyEte BavantIti bAhumAtrEH pariDimirArdrESca Bavitavyam । iDustu SuzkaH inDanatvAdeva dviprAdeSaSca tena te iDmEkadeSaBUtAH pariDitvAyAsamaToH syuH tadidamAha aByADAnAya hIti Suzko hyAdAvADeyaH yAvatKara mAtraAhavanIMye Kare samBavantItyaBiprAyaH yastu pariDivudDyA Aharati so'vaDyavezwanIyAdagniKarAdatiriktamevAharati agnivezwanaM ca dAhaBayAnna Sulvamiti ta'ezAvakxptA iti” kAtyA॰ 1, 3, 14, 21 । “aparamitaM praRayanIyaM triyUnama” sU॰ । “praRayanasyAyaM praRayanIyaH taM praRayanIyamagnipraRayanArTamiDmamaparimitamaparimitakAzWakvaM triyUnaM tisfBiH saMnahanarajjuBirvezwitaM kuryyAt trIRi yUnAni banDanAni yasya sa triyUnaH taM triyUnamiti । aparimitatvaM ca prAgukteDmakAzWasaMKyApekzayAtiSayenADikasaMKyakAzWakatvam । tena caturviMSatisAmiDenIko zEzwakApaSustatra saptaviMSatiH kAzWAni Bavanti । tataSca praRayanIye tato 'pyaDikAni azwAviMSatipraBftIni izwakAsaMKyAni kAzWAni Bavanti” karka॰ । Candogapa॰ “prAdeSadvayamiDmasya pramARaM parikIrttitam । evaMmitAH syureveha saziDaH sarvvakarmmasu । samiDo'zwAdaSedmasyapravadanti manIziRaH । darSe ca pOrRRamAse ca kriyAsvanyAsu viMSatiH । samidAdizu homezumantradEvatavarjjitA । purastAccoparizwAcca inDanArTaM samidBavet । iDmo'pyeDArTamAcAryyerhavirAhutizu smftaH । yatra cAsya nivfttiHsyAttat spazwIkaravARyaham । aNgahomasamittantrasozyantyAKyezu karmmasu । yezAM cEtaduparyyuktaM tezu tatsadfSezu ca । akzaBaNgAdivipadi jalahomAdikarmmaRi । somAhutizu sarvvAsu nEtezviDmo viDIyate । “iDmajAtIyakAzWArdDapramARaM mekzaRaM Bavet” । “sunvandaBItiriDmaBftiH pakTyakEH” f॰ 6, 20, 13 । “iDmAnAM kAzWAnAM BftiH” BA॰ । tuzitadevagaRamede sa ca BAga॰ 4 ska॰ 1 a॰ darSito yaTA “tozaH pratozaH santozo BadraH SAntirilaspatiH । iDmaH kavirviBuH svAhnaH sudevo rocanodvizaw । tuzitA nAma te devA Asan svAyamBuve'ntare” BAga॰ ।
m: इध्म m. (n., L.) fuel in, general
fuel as used for the sacred fire, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr.; ĀśvGṛ.; MBh. &c.
(अस्), m. N. of an Āṅgirasa, GopBr.;
a: इध्मः — [इध्यतेऽग्निरनेन इंध्-मक्] Fuel, especially that used for the sacred fire; ग्रीष्म इध्मः शरद्धविः Rv. 10. 90. 6; R. 14. 70. --ध्मं Wood, fuel. --Comp. --जिह्वः fire. --प्रव्रश्चनः a hatchet, an axe.

k.v: काष्ठं दार्विन्धनं त्वेध इध्ममेधः समित्स्त्रियाम्. निष्कुहः कोटरं वा ना वल्लरिर्मञ्जरिः स्त्रियौ॥

m: इध्म—भृति (इध्म˚). mfn. bringing fuel, RV. vi, 20, 13.
इध्म—चिति f. a pile of wood, ĀśvGṛ. iv, 2, 14.
इध्म—जिह्व m. ‘the fuel's tongue’, fire, BhP. v, 1, 25
(also N. of a son of Priya-vrata, ib.)
इध्म—परिवासन n. chip of wood, MānŚr.
इध्म—प्रोक्षण n. sprinkling the firewood, L.
इध्म—संनहन n. a string for fastening fuel together, ŚBr.

v: pu॰ lopAmudrAgarBajAte agastyaputre fziBede “sahasrasammitaH putra eko'pyastu tapoDana!” iti lopAmudrayAprArTito'gastyastasyA putramutpAdayAsa tasya nAma dfdasyuriDmavahanAcca iDmavAha iti nAmAntaraM tadeduktaM BA॰ va॰ । 99 । “tata ADAya garBantamagamat vanameva saH” “tasminvanagate garBovavfDe sapta SAradAn । saptame'vde gate cATa prAcyavat sa mahojjvalaH । jvaladagnipraBAvena dfQasyurnAma BArata! । sANgopanizadAn vedAn japanniva mahAtapAH । tasya putro'BavadfzeH sa tapasvI mahAdvijaH । sa vAlaeva tejasvI pitustasya nideSane । iDmAnAM BAravahanAcceDmavAhastato'Bavat” ।
m: इध्म—वाह m. N. of a son of Agastya, MBh.; BhP.
इध्म—वत् (इध्म˚), mfn. furnished or provided with fuel, TBr. ii, 1, 3, 8 [misprinted इध्य˚].
